Build/recover/invalidate/retire match build ID confirmations; cleanup/recover-files require fresh selection confirmations, disposable test guards and stopped writers for recovery execution.
M05.read_only: validate/inspect repeat without mutation, including corrupt input. Rollback uses read-only repeatable-read and rolls back without changing selection. Retirement/recovery previews preserve bytes and do not commit. Mocked sessions/lineage prove unit behavior only.
M05.ordinary_operations: Startup creates a loader component once; request orchestration uses immutable scoring/readiness. No builder/cleaner calls in request/startup/migration/catalog seed paths. Make test/test-ml select unit suites, with explicit test-scoped temporary fixture builds only. Build/registration/physical cleanup remain explicit operator services; existing privacy invalidation and authorized data deletion are unchanged.
M05.wrappers: Phase8 runner and E2E fixture/live/lifecycle wrappers explicitly select guarded setup/build flows. Shared ownership teardown checks unique disposable project labels, removes only owned resources and verifies absence; it does not fit/promote/retire artifacts. This is source review, not a new real-stack replay.
